_comment: NOT LAUNCHED (24 Oct 2026). Long-carry cell X throughput probes (PREREGISTRATION_DRAFT.md section 10 costs X at 0.3x of P16): the CUDA gate (tools/colab_cuda_validate.sh, now with test_llama_attnres: the depth_attend kernels against the host loop and device training steps), then 300-step probes of P16 and X at T 1,024 and X at T 512 (against E1's probe_20m_L16, 25,383 tok/s). The X ratio is probe_X_T1024's tok_per_s_steady over probe_P16_T1024's; peak_gpu_mem_mib gives the activation cost. The corpus is E1's T 512 mix (no T 1,024 data job exists yet): mtstudio draws random windows of T tokens from the id stream, so the rate does not depend on the windowing; the T 1,024 data job replaces it before any training run. About 0.5 L4 VM-hours. Afterwards, at home: copy ART/probe_*/summary.json to experiments/tiny_chat_long_2026-10/stage0/ and record the ratio in PREREGISTRATION_DRAFT.md section 10. Upload vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf with the runner's --upload.
